title: Visit
description: One animal or person in front of the feeder, from presence detected to presence gone. Inside a meal it is an item of meal.visits. Outside meal times it is its own document: visits/{visit_id} with home_id. Written by the feeder.

home_id.description: Required when the visit is a standalone document.

classification.description: Answer of the recognition server. not_checked when the server was unreachable.

dog_id.description: Set only when classification is known_dog.

confidence.description: Confidence of the best match. null when not_checked.

outcome.description: What the feeder did. blocked_wrong_dog: another known dog during this meal. served_offline: owner order fallback without recognition.

grams_eaten.description: Drop of the bowl weight during this visit, attributed to whoever was in front of the camera.

photo_url.description: Kept for unknown dogs so the owner can see who came.
